title: Grateful Dead Live at Euphoria Ballroom on 1970-07-16

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard recording with crystal‑clear mix, highlighted by a soaring Not Fade Away, magical Attics of My Life, and a flawless NFA → St Stephen transition.
ai_review.review: The set‑2 tape from July 16 1970 delivers a superb listening experience – the SBD source is clean, well‑balanced, and captures every nuance of the band’s late‑70s firepower. Musically the show shines with Bob Weir’s blistering guitar on Not Fade Away, an unforgettable Attics of My Life, and one of the most seamless NFA into St Stephen segues ever recorded. Reviewers consistently praise both the audio fidelity and the inspired performances.

ai_rating.rationale: All eight reviews are 4‑5 stars, praising both the high‑quality soundboard source and exceptional musical moments; weighted average yields a strong rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Praised as an SBD master with a great mix, crisp tone captured from Ampex tape transfers; listeners note solid‑state amps, 7½ ips speed and no audible flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows beautifully, especially the NFA → St Stephen transition; guitar interplays and band energy are highlighted throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Interplay with Bob is praised; his tone and rhythmic support noted as strong.
band_member_comments.Bob: Multiple reviewers call his guitar on Not Fade Away, Attics of My Life and the NFA jam "beyond belief" and a highlight of the performance.
